snippet.description:
This is one of the machines that I need to make neodymium magnets, and it's actually kind of scary.

This is because it can use a ridiculous amount of power to generate a massive magnetic field that's similar in strength to an MRI machine.

This super strong magnetic field is super noticeable if anything magnetic is brought near it, and if something gets too close, it violently shoots towards the center of the machine, which can be extremely dangerous.

#shorts
